details.counter: adreno_get_gpu_halt calls atomic_inc(&adreno_dev->halt). put uses atomic_dec_if_positive and WARN on returnednegative;read uses rmb/atomic_read;clear sets0 and wmb. Counter has no reason/owner/epoch token and no register/queue/IRQ access. A positive count is software admission state,not physical GPU halted;0 is not DMA retirement,power/security readiness or a provider lease. Actual selected Linux atomic/WARN config/runtime not executed/bound.
details.normal_admission: hwsched_sendcmd first allocates command metadata and takes device mutex/adjusts scheduling,then _abort_submission reads halt/fault after barrier. If set it returns-EBUSY via original cleanup before inflight increment/submit callback. Thus source gate is not an allocator-free operation and not an immutable hardware capability check. hwsched_sendcmds may requeue returned errors;no retry policy altered or exercised.
details.mid_command: Hardware-fence throttle sets SLEEP/MAX flags and gets softwarehalt,then arms timer. _disable clears pointer/ts and flags under fence lock;only if MAX was set does it put softwarehalt and trigger/wake. The gate is checked per normal draw submission,not between every fence inside an already-admitted callback. Existing state ownership and global counter balance cannot be inferred from one boolean pair.
details.submit_exceptions: Inspected actual hwsched_ops->submit_drawobj call sites are normal sendcmd and direct adreno_hwsched_replay. Replay calls callback without _abort_submission/adreno_gpu_halt gate and discards its int result. Recurring send helper has its own halt/fault entry check,while replay also discards its return. A universal all-submit admission guarantee is therefore not present in this module source. No new gate added that could obstruct intended recovery replay.
details.setup: Actual process_hw_fence_queue checks MAX and calls setup under fence lock. setup first gets a contextref,then unconditionally overwrites defer_drawctxt/ts and calls gen7_hwsched_active_count_get without checking its int return. It does not compare an existing deferred owner or put a replaced reference. Normal halt may limit later normal submissions,but cannot alone prove no replacement via replay/already-admitted work. Do not claim an actual leak/overwrite occurred without relevant pending-fence/source-owner conditions.
details.activecount_domain: gen7_hwsched_active_count_get requires device mutex,can reject PMsuspend or propagate boot error,and increments active_cnt only on0. This is distinct from halt counter and contextkref. Setup ignoring that API return does not make activecount availability/power ownership a fact. Stable caller conditions may exclude some failures;no speculative balance repair or raw SUCCESS value invented.
details.other_owners: Known hwsched_idle and PMsuspend/resume also take/release softwarehalt. idle drops device mutex to flush/wait and later puts halt/retriggers even on waiterror. These are existing reference paths,not new idle/stop tests or bounded hardware shutdown evidence. No global ownership balance proof from inspected subset or absent call of clearhelper.
details.decision: No single-owner/generation/refcount/cancel/retry/reset/admission policy invented. A softwarehalt gate is not sufficient justification to repair setup replacement,or to gate all replay calls. No21st patch;18th/19th/20th remain independent UNAPPLIED with their explicit limits. Next binds returned replay callback API status and current private ownership state without changing recovery behavior.
